execution.note: Counts source batches only; derived views are selections, not additional calls. Four capacity failures were retried with unchanged settings and prompts. Successful outputs were never replaced.

maintenance_checks.behavioral_checks: 16 generated outputs, eight primary anonymous comparisons, one swapped-order follow-up; calibration tracked separately.

limitations: Four independent synthetic source families, eight task variants; only two families were held out.
User requests state the intended effect explicitly, so evidence for inferring intent from sparse context is limited.
One generation per version and task; no reliable improvement or failure rate estimate.
Same model family generated and judged outputs; no human author or professional Chinese editor blind review was conducted.
The rain example calibrates judging and appears in the runtime example; it is not an unseen skill evaluation.
All R3 cases are consumed for future rounds. Packaging and unit checks are not behavioral passes.
Text-only tests do not revalidate file editing, all 28 permanent cases, other models or all varieties of Chinese.
next_evidence: Use fresh material where intent must be inferred from context and sentence function, with plainness and expressiveness in the same passage.
Review voice and rhetorical patterns across outputs, not only compliance with explicit requests.
Prefer actual user revision feedback or independent Chinese editorial review when available; never invent external review.
